Settings & backup

Your settings and records stay on this device.

When disabled, numbers are generated automatically. When enabled, you may edit the number on the bill screen. Duplicate numbers are blocked.

Optional AI assistant

AI is OFF by default. When OFF, AI settings stay hidden and no AI request is made. To use AI, enter a compatible API endpoint, model and API key. API charges/privacy depend on your provider.

Do not enable AI unless you trust the provider. Offline billing still works with AI disabled.

🔐 Permissions & privacy

Camera access is requested only when you choose Scan bill. OCR runs on this device in the Android app; photos and customer data are not uploaded by the scanner. You can revoke camera permission in Android app settings. Browser-only mode may show the photo picker without built-in OCR.

Warning: clearing browser storage or uninstalling/clearing the app can erase local records. Export backups regularly.
